summary: Active fixed-term crypto-asset lending service currently branded HashKey Japan and launched by Tokyo Hash on 2021-12-15. Customers lend crypto assets under a consumption-loan arrangement and receive the same type/equivalent quantity plus contractual lending fees at maturity.
what_happened: Tokyo Hash announced the lending service launch for 2021-12-15. The current HashKey Japan first-party page continues to describe the service as an active fixed-term crypto-asset consumption-loan product, with maximum 100-day lending periods, no mid-term cancellation in principle, crypto-denominated lending fees, and operator-described deployment of borrowed assets within HashKey Group.
uncertainty_notes: The 2021-12-15 launch is supported by first-party launch authority under Tokyo Hash. The exact date and legal mechanics of the later Tokyo Hash to HashKey Japan branding/entity transition are not inferred here. Published rates and HashKey Group operation statements remain issuer terms/claims rather than independently verified realized returns, reserves, segregation, insurance, solvency or guaranteed repayment.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000140 after candidate-only PR #292 passed the hardened exact-head scanner against the 118-platform canonical corpus.
